display.text:
import json

import requests as rq

data = rq.post(
    "http://localhost:9625/v1/chat/completions",
    json={
        "model": "deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash",
        "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "Привет"}],
        "stream": False,
    },
)
if data.status_code != 200:
    print(
        json.dumps(
            {"code": data.status_code, "content": data.content.decode()},
            indent=4,
            ensure_ascii=False,
        )
    )
else:
    json_ = json.loads(data.content)
    print(
        json.dumps(
            json_,
            indent=4,
            ensure_ascii=False,
        )
    )
